provider: RQData; existing user authorization; no credential persisted

request.status: Exploratory feasibility trial; dependent-data significance not validated
request.author_request: One stock-day per observation; daily price shape and activity features. No GARCH in main analysis.
request.selection: Reuse fixed 2017 historical cohort, not current sector universe; no replacement by observed results.
request.testing: 2024; first 20 market trading dates reserved as buffer, all remaining valid daily observations

features.overnight_log_return: 100*log(adjusted open / previous market trading-day adjusted close)
features.close_position: (close-low)/(high-low); 0.5 if high==low on a traded day
features.turnover_today: RQData get_turnover_rate today, vendor units retained, no rolling mean

request.scaling: Pooled fitting-only scale, shared across stocks. No per-stock or per-period centering/scaling.
request.missing: No price/feature interpolation. Current and previous date must be traded and unsuspended. Keep original calendar.
request.hypotheses: Within each fixed sector: equality of the five stocks daily five-feature marginal distributions.
request.diagnostics: Price-only first four coordinates as prespecified descriptive/learner diagnostic, no independent formal discoveries.
request.interpretation: Ordinary label permutations are an IID reference diagnostic only, not valid real-market p-values under dependence. Never claim significance or equivalence from this trial.
